title: 039 NNPredict -- framework stage (research R6): the NNNC entry framework on NNPredict, identity first, then one feature per arm on the R7-selected model
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; it selects the model the framework and sizer stages use.
selected_from: verdicts_threshold.json selected_union (R7 over the 5 op arms + 3 threshold arms): nnp_lstm_ind_op, -12.73 pp, every model arm FAILs vs nnp_ridge_op on paired verdicts
identity_rule: fw0 (NNPredictStrategy with EntryFrameworkMixin, everything off) must reproduce nnp_lstm_ind_op's trades_hash on all 15 folds; otherwise the port is a defect and no feature verdict is read

nnp_lstm_ind_op_g24.change: stoploss grace 24 h (NNNC default since the framework study)

nnp_lstm_ind_op_famm.change: momentum family exits (no take-profit, 24 h unclog)

nnp_lstm_ind_op_gate.change: entry = model AND the gbb trigger (trigger_and_model)

instrument: per arm: a record for all 15 folds, model trained per fold on its training window (run_folds strict artefact check), and trades in both halves; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (no P&L read)
alone: judge_one(arm, nnp_lstm_ind_op_fw0) with the rule maps; liveness: an arm whose trades change on no fold is INERT (a defect, not a null)
decision: PASS -> candidate NNPredict default (reported; adoption is the user's call); PASS with whole-period gain < seed_rule_pp needs a seed-2 rerun
all_arms_reuse_weights: asserted by build_arms (model keys equal) and by the recorded model_key hash 50ccbec98c1fbdc4 at f00 after the port
seen_before: every 039 model, operating-point and threshold verdict (verdicts_op.json, verdicts_threshold.json)
the decile checks (early half) and the failed sizer screen (screen.json)
NNNC's results for these four features (grace 24 h adopted; in-profit add default; momentum exits for breakout entries; trigger gate)
note: the selected model loses money standalone (-12.73 pp); this stage tests whether NNNC's framework features improve it, not whether it is deployable
